decision_object.decision_name: Department design for a fintech startup
decision_object.trigger_condition: New fintech org; orientation complete (US, payments, regulated)
decision_object.current_state: No departments; research done on payments regs + competitors
decision_object.evidence_threshold: Each instantiated line justified by a capability the org must perform
decision_object.decision_criteria: Cover required capabilities; minimize duplication; respect regulatory need
decision_object.constraints: US payments => Legal + Risk/Compliance mandatory; small team => merge Ops+CS initially
decision_object.escalation_conditions: Regulator requires a function we propose to drop
decision_object.expected_outcome: org-structure.json with 12 instantiated lines + charters + manifest
decision_object.verification_method: Each line traces to a required capability + charter file exists
decision_object.actual_outcome: 12 lines instantiated; Compliance mandatory kept; Ops+CS merged
decision_object.learning_extracted: Regulatory lines should never be dropped for lean reasons

learning_ledger.case: Design departments for a US payments fintech
learning_ledger.decision: Instantiate 12 of 20 lines; merge Ops+CS; keep Compliance
learning_ledger.assumption: Small team cannot staff all 20 separately
learning_ledger.action: Map capabilities; write charters; emit manifest
learning_ledger.expected_result: Coverage of required capabilities, no gaps
learning_ledger.learning: Regulatory lines are mandatory regardless of lean preference
learning_ledger.rule_update: Never drop Legal/Risk-Compliance for a regulated industry
